mapper.select: WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO content_like (content_id, visitor_id) SELECT c.id, #{visitorId} FROM content c WHERE c.code = #{contentCode} AND c.status = 'published' ON CONFLICT (content_id, visitor_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING content_id ), updated AS ( UPDATE content SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE code = #{contentCode} AND status = 'published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) RETURNING like_count ) SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT like_count FROM updated), (SELECT like_count FROM content WHERE code = #{contentCode} AND status = 'published'), 0 ) AS like_count
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(like_count), 0) FROM content WHERE code = #{contentCode} AND status = 'published'
